about: Rule corner cases for tests/unit/rulesDifferential.test.js. positions: a FEN with moves that must / must not be legal (long algebraic, promotions with the piece letter) and optionally the expected end ('checkmate' | 'stalemate'), insufficient (material) and fifty (50-move rule) flags. lines: moves played from fen (default: the start position); threefoldAt is the first ply at which the position has occurred three times, results maps a ply to the game result expected there (null: game goes on), finalMust / finalMustNot are checked in the last position, finalFen is the position it must be, lastMove describes the MoveEvent of the last move. Every position and every ply of every line is also compared with chess.js.
